given: a stock position whose batch or serial has no value
when: the operator views that stock position
then: the empty field displays an explicit 'none yet' indicator rather than being left blank, so the operator can tell the field is intentionally empty rather than missing

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts populated batch and serial render as distinct labelled values; AC2 asserts the empty branch shows an explicit 'none yet' placeholder. A view that renders populated values correctly could still leave an empty field blank, so this fails independently.

architectural_notes: E2E: the NULL-branch of the same render path. The boundary (app/routes) serializes a NULL batch_number/serial_number as JSON null (the S1 nullable-column policy, PI3); the React stock-view component maps null to an explicit 'none yet' indicator rather than a blank region (R5 clean-render-of-missing-optional-detail preference). This placeholder is a client presentation concern, NOT a service or repository default: app/services and app/repositories pass the NULL through untouched so the field's absence stays observable. Owner module: client stock-view component (null -> 'none yet' mapping). Verified by a client component test on the null branch and a real-branch integration test that the boundary emits JSON null for an unpopulated field.
